Primary Racing NSW2005–06,2006–07 and2007–08 reports name him and his constituency on the statutory advisory committee. Official biography calls it Council; reports use Committee/Group. Three consecutive report-period observations strengthen the chronology but do not establish continuous tenure or exact endpoints. The2004–05 original annual report lists M Thistlewaite [source spelling] as Industry Employees representative. Attribution to Matt is contextual inference from matching initial, advisory group and the worker constituency corroborated by2005–08 later records; do not treat a misspelled abbreviated listing as an exact appointment instrument.2008–09 report instead describes the Racing Industry Consultation Group established under2008 amendment, with a Unions NSW seat but no Thistlethwaite name found. Committee restructuring is not his actual resignation date or proof he transferred to successor group. Endpoints stay unknown.
